review_scope: Obtained BondDepository.sol complete main body (199 lines), NET.sol complete main body (254 lines), Constants.sol (80 lines), existing publisher Bond ABI; selected economic and capacity claims bound to source excerpts and exact retained runtime bytes. Not a new compiler reproduction, exhaustive dependency review, or security audit. No financial history is packaged.
source_association: Retained source_code and deployed_bytecode fields from the same explorer smart-contract endpoint; collector matches exact decoded-byte SHA256 at snapshot and interval start. Explorer association is not independent compiler equivalence.

reviewed_claims.epoch: floor((timestamp-startTime)/28800); startTime written once on enable, not genesis finalization or a UTC/staking epoch.
reviewed_claims.capacity: Every deposit computes floor(current NET totalSupply*25/10000) before its own mint; used payoutInEpoch shared by both markets; cap is not snapshotted. Availability=max(0,cap-used).
reviewed_claims.threshold: NET mint/burn are the only totalSupply writes and emit Transfer from/to zero; ordinary transfer to zero forbidden. Group all supply changes and BondCreated by transaction, never test transient intermediate writes. First observed post-transaction availability strictly<1e9; no initial-zero-capacity instant sellout.
reviewed_claims.deposit: Market0 transferFrom(caller,Treasury,amount) USDG; market1 canonical LP. Payout=floor(valueWad*1e9/price); cap check then Treasury mint to BondDepository then note and BondCreated. Event depositor is beneficiary to, not necessarily payer.
reviewed_claims.prices: bondPrice=max(floor(TWAP*9700/10000),Treasury.backingPerToken), WAD USDG/NET. Requested opening NAV is fresh historical Treasury getter; requested opening spot is canonical v2 reserve ratio, neither bondPrice nor TWAP.
reviewed_claims.vesting: BOND_VEST=2 days; any older interface comment saying5days is stale. Redeem moves already-minted custody and does not increment payoutInEpoch or totalSupply.
reviewed_claims.lp: LP quote valued by source 2*floor(sqrt(quoteRaw*USDGfactor*netRaw*1e9))*lpAmount/LPsupply with floor mulDiv; this is not actual USDG delivered.
reviewed_claims.permissions: deposit requires enabled, nonzero amount, valid market, oracle read, caller max price and shared cap; external token/Treasury authorization remains a dependency. enable requires wired and GenesisBond caller once. No user transaction is authorized by this catalog.

limits: NET/USDG/LP decimals and canonical pointers checked live; constants are source-generation rules, not historical output.
No independently reproduced Solidity compiler output. No static current financial state; runtime identity alone does not prove complete event history.
Treasury NAV getter is reported, not used to clear existing independent Core POL/haircut reconstruction blocker.
Exact receipt transfers are gross attributed incoming; other receipt cash is excluded, not silently attributed to bonds.
